notes.title: Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

We're excited to share the Adult VR Game Room development roadmap with you on Steam!
If you've played our recent development build (available on our Patreon page), you already know that we're adding new male characters to the game in a new update later this month! As well as a new ability to fuse males and females together to create characters with any combination of male and female physical traits. Futa? No problem! That's an easy one!

There's more exciting new features and content coming down the pipeline. Check out the development roadmap and let us know which milestone you're most excited about. 
Here's just a small preview of the new content we've been working on.
